TAL_DUAL_WIELDING_CRITICAL_FOLLOW_UP.why: Critical Follow-Up: the readied-pair Paired Strike is a native critical hit on 19 or 20; no extra cost.

tianxia.talent.beastmastery.lookout.why: You and your tamed beasts and mount within 30 feet of you share the highest passive Perception among you (combat/ext/beastmastery_tamer.py, rider lane C10).

tianxia.talent.blacksmith.portable_forge.why: A fight starts with the smith holding a Forge Mark from its prepared item (combat/ext/blacksmith_kit.py, rider lane C10). Allies' prepared items stay with the GM.

tianxia.talent.beastmastery.pack_attack.why: Your Beast Allies have Advantage on attacks when another conscious Beast Ally is within 5 feet of the target.
